subtitle: Landmark Travel & Campus Tours
promotional_text: Explore 1,900 famous buildings in 140 cities on a 3D map, plan your trip, and collect a stamp at each one. Visiting colleges? 112 campuses are in there too.
whats_new:
New in 2.7
• 11 new campuses, including Caltech, Johns Hopkins, Rice, NYU and Carnegie Mellon, plus Adrian Smith's towers: Burj Khalifa in Dubai and Trump International Hotel & Tower in Chicago.
• Campus pages have a History card, Game Day with upcoming home games and a link to live scores, and event calendars from 11 schools.
• College Facts for US campuses: acceptance and graduation rates, tuition and earnings after graduation.
• Architect pages: tap an architect's name to see their story and all their buildings.
• A photo gallery on every landmark, plus historic photos and drawings from the Library of Congress for US landmarks.
• Restaurants and hotels near each landmark, with street photos and walking times, plus food tours and guided tours from GetYourGuide.
• More events: six months ahead, a mix of concerts, shows and games, and a See all list. Library and museum events in 9 cities.
• Map pins group into numbered bubbles when you zoom out.
• The architecture quiz has photo questions and explains each answer.
• A cleaner home screen, city pages split into tabs, and search in your Passport.

Fixes
• City maps show their pins as soon as they open.
• Each event shows once, even when two ticket sellers list it.
description:
Stamped! turns the world's great buildings into a passport to fill. Explore more than 1,900 architectural landmarks in 140 cities and 112 university campuses, earn a stamp for every one you visit, and fly through real cities on a photoreal 3D map.

PLAN YOUR COLLEGE VISITS
• 112 campuses: every Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 school, the Ivy League, and great campuses around the world
• Save the schools you're considering to My College List
• Make a College Road Trip: a day at each school, in a short driving order
• Plan a Campus Visit: a one-day walking tour of a campus's landmarks
• Find hotels near campus for each night of your trip

CAMPUS TRADITIONS
• Over 250 campus traditions to do or see, from lucky statues to bells and famous gates
• Check them off as you go and earn the Traditions Keeper badge
• Campus stamps in school colors

PLAN ANY TRIP
• Plan several days of landmarks and your own saved places
• Reorder stops, see walking times and optimize your route
• Fly through your trip on the 3D map, day by day
• Your trips and college list sync with iCloud
• Restaurants, hotels, tours and local events around your stops

EXPLORE IN 3D
• Photoreal 3D city and campus maps with satellite imagery
• A guided tour that flies between every landmark
• Look Around previews of the streets before you go
• Map filters for food, coffee, culture and places to stay

COLLECT STAMPS
• Earn a passport stamp for every landmark you visit
• Follow your progress on the world map, by city, country and conference
• Unlock achievements and share your passport
• See your progress at a glance with the Home Screen widget

DISCOVER THE STORIES
• Architects, build dates, styles and history for every building
• A 10-question architecture quiz for every city and campus
• Search by name, architect or campus nickname
• Architect pages, photo galleries and historic photos from the Library of Congress

Available in 9 languages, with high-contrast and reduced-motion options.

Stamped! is not affiliated with or endorsed by any university. School names and colors are used only to identify them.
